changed: When you move through the app with the keyboard, the focused control now gets a solid outline just outside it, including list rows, navigation items, checkboxes, switches and radio buttons.

With Reduce motion on, screens, dialogs, date pickers and bottom sheets appear at once instead of animating in, and expanding sections open without animating. On iPhone and iPad you can still swipe from the edge to go back.

Screen titles now sit at the left of the title bar on every platform and are set in the app's display typeface, as are dialog titles and the titles of empty screens; the title bar no longer changes colour when content scrolls under it.

Menus, bottom sheets, tooltips, segmented buttons, expanding sections and the add button now share the app's rounded corners; in High contrast, segmented buttons, expanding sections, the add button, icon buttons, suggestion lists and the date and time pickers are outlined like cards and dialogs, and a rule separates the title bar from the page.
fixed: Status chips and banners draw their icon dark enough to stand out from the chip's tint in every palette; the Broken icon in Everforest Light was slightly too faint.
